title: Local Manager environment-bound pairing, database recovery and rollback-safe Windows updates

phases.objective: Prove environment isolation, exact device recovery, least-privilege database evidence, release-channel integrity and rollback-safe update handoff without granting Production mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Local Manager Windows device link and environment readiness
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The selected environment, device, database writer, release artifact and update handoff are exact and fail closed when identity or evidence is missing.
steps: Resolve an explicit staging or production runtime identity before release or database authority selection.
Bind the device recovery handoff to the exact device identity and return route supplied by the pairing journey.
Verify the dedicated writer account, environment marker, database target and non-grantable least-privilege matrix.
Select only a canonical GitHub release URL from the runtime-specific release channel after URL normalization.
Stage the Windows executable, verify staged bytes, retain the previous version, self-test the replacement and roll back on failure.
Build and certify Sidecar contracts under both production and staging compile profiles.
assertions: Missing or conflicting runtime identity never defaults to Production release selection.
Cross-channel, dot-segment and wrong-tag release artifacts are rejected by the server policy.
A failed device provisioning request never marks the device journey complete.
CURRENT_USER() must match the configured writer and GRANT OPTION is forbidden at global, schema and table scope.
Sidecar certification compiles with the same environment contract as the Windows application.
The updater never overwrites the live executable directly and retains an automatic rollback path.

phases.objective: Run governed live Staging acceptance against a clean database, an incomplete database and an interrupted write cycle.
Certify repeated Windows update, failed self-test rollback, reconnect and unknown-commit recovery behavior.
This PR does not authorize a Production canary or deployment.
Production promotion, database migration, grant mutation and release signing remain separately governed.
